title: [EXA-3] `did:key` used where a DID-document service entry is required
description: Review finding EXA-3: `did:key` used where a DID-document service entry is required (lens EXA). Location: spec/05-messaging.md:432; spec/09-interop.md:88, 102; spec/06-calls.md:251, 358, 383 (vs 06:372). Fix: As the reviewer proposed. The 02:14 table says `did:key` has "No: document derived from the key", and a `did:key` profile or KP pointer goes through Pkarr. A `did:key` gateway or recorder therefore cannot carry the `KeyPackageEndpoint` that 06:372 requires. Use `did:webvh:...` for the gateway and recorder. In §5.2.7.4, note that `did:key` users rely only on the in-group declaration. Full text: notes/review/EXA-verified.md and notes/review/EXA.md.
close_reason: FIXED per notes/review/reconciliation.md: spec/09-interop.md §9.2 gateway id did:webvh:...:agora:gateway#gateway; 06-calls.md §6.12 grantedTo/recorderDID did:webvh:...:agora:recorder; 05-messaging.md §5.2.7.4 uses did:webvh id and "A did:key user cannot publish this entry ... uses only the in-group declaration"
